name: Penalty Status Reason 2 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for the status of the penalty.

SUSP.name: Trading Suspended
SUSP.definition: Penalty was removed becuase of ISIN suspension from trading.

TECH.name: Technical Impossibilities
TECH.definition: Penalty was removed becuase there were thecnical imposssibilities at the CSD level that prevent settlement, such as: a failure of the infrastructure components, a cyber-attack, network problems.

SWIC.name: Switched
SWIC.definition: Penalty has been switched between the failing and non-failing party.

SESU.name: Settlement Suspended
SESU.definition: Penalty was removed becuase of ISIN suspension from settlement due to a reconciliation issue under Article 65 (2) and (6) of the RTS on CSD Requirements.

SEMP.name: Settlement On Multiple Platforms
SEMP.definition: Settlement on multiple platforms where one of the platforms is closed for settlement (either cash or securities).

RALO.name: Reallocated
RALO.definition: Re-allocation of a late matching fail penalty from the instructing party to the delivering/receiving party.

INTS.name: Internalised Settlement
INTS.definition: Penalty is not computed because the settlement has been internalised.

INSO.name: Insolvency
INSO.definition: Penalty was removed becuase insolvency proceedings are opened against the failing participant.

CORP.name: Corporate Action
CORP.definition: Specifies that due to a specific corporate action, the security does no longer exists.

NOSU.name: Not Subject
NOSU.definition: Penalty is not computed or removed because the security is not subject to penalties.
